slice: childList fragment-expansion records + previous/nextSibling fields + el.remove() records + surroundContents record order
context: R46 follow-up: MutationObserver-childList remaining clusters (fragment additions / sibling fields / remove records / surroundContents order).

fixes.fragment_expansion: appendChild/insertBefore/replaceChild with a DocumentFragment now record addedNodes = the fragment's children (pre-flatten snapshot, i.e. the existing ceAdded) — the fragment itself never enters the tree and must not appear in the record. Previously all three recorded [fragmentProxy].
fixes.sibling_fields: childList records now carry previousSibling/nextSibling: appendChild captures the container's lastChild before writing (prev) and null (next); insertBefore captures refNode.previousSibling and refNode itself; el.remove() captures both siblings before detaching. WPT asserts these on fragment-addition and Range.insertNode subtests.
fixes.remove_records: element.remove() now emits a childList removed record on the parent (was entirely missing — surroundContents' per-removal records depend on it). A _zwSuppressRemoveRecord flag lets composite operations suppress per-call notifies.
fixes.surround_contents_order: record order and tree-operation order are decoupled: removed records must be in document order (WPT expects [removed-first, removed-last, added]) but the tree ops must stay reverse-order removal — forward removal breaks nth-child selectors and removes wrong nodes (caught live by the renderer R2930 quickjs test: #sc ended with 2 children). surroundContents snapshots each child's siblings in document order, sets the suppress flag, removes in reverse (correct tree), then emits the document-order records itself.
regressions_caught_in_round: renderer R2930 surroundContents quickjs test broke twice: (1) forward remove broke nth-child removal (2 children left); (2) the first decoupled version referenced out-of-scope sel/handle in the _makeRange closure (QuickJS 'sel is not defined'). Both fixed; renderer back to 55P+126P.

results.remaining_1f: surroundContents second removed record previousSibling: JS-side previousSibling reads host state which still contains the not-yet-applied first removal (deferred apply) — needs synchronous sibling visibility (M1 L2), deferred with diagnosis
